texts.orig: The all-in-one platform strategy that PostHog is executing is really interesting to me. I rarely see it done this well, because it’s hard to do. But if you pull it off—like they are—you can build a generational business. Being able to follow an issue from a session recording, to its impact in analytics, to shipping a fix as a feature flag, to testing a variant, to collecting feedback with surveys—that’s the holy grail.
